notes: P03 PST-X05_transparency_ref deliverable: evaluation/venue2027/pst/merkle_transparency.py implements the Merkle inclusion and consistency proof model aligned with RFC 9162 (Certificate Transparency v2) and RFC 6962. It provides SHA-256 leaf and interior nodes (0x00 and 0x01 domain-separated prefixes), append(entry)->int, root_hash()->str, inclusion_proof(index, size)->list[str], consistency_proof(m, n)->list[str], verify_inclusion(entry, index, size, proof, root)->bool, and verify_consistency(m, n, root_m, root_n, proof)->bool. Explicitly disclaims equating public immutable hash trees with encrypted secrecy (transparency is for public tamper-evidence, NOT confidentiality; retention decay and privacy require cryptographic key management and purpose-bound minimization). Test suite test_merkle_transparency.py covers positive controls (leaf append, root computation matching RFC test vectors including empty tree SHA-256('') and RFC 6962 Section 2.1.3 7-leaf intermediate node graph, inclusion proofs across sizes 1..25, and consistency proofs across 1 <= m <= n <= 20) and adversarial controls (tampered leaf fails, tampered root fails, forged inclusion/consistency proofs fail, diverged tree branches fail, out-of-bounds parameters fail closed, stable reason codes). All unit and regression tests pass; ruff lint and format check clean.
